title: NRO Corona satellites immediately imaging UFOs under Eisenhower
summary: UAPGerb tells of NRO Corona satellites immediately imaging UFOs under Eisenhower, about late 1950s-1960s at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: there's a theory that could be constructed that as soon as we got the NRO up there with their taking over the Corona satellite program and all sorts of keyhole satellites, they immediately started getting a bunch of imagery and signals intelligence of a bunch of UFOs.

plain: A researcher who goes by UAPGerb, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels, suggests that in the late 1950s and 1960s, under President Eisenhower, the National Reconnaissance Office, the US agency that runs spy satellites, took over Corona, the country's first spy satellite programme, and later launched more spy satellites known as Keyhole. He says one could build a theory that these satellites almost at once began picking up photos and radio signals of many UFOs. If so, the US government would have held hard evidence of UFOs since the early space age.
